name: Agent Skills
description: Install agent skills at runtime using existing gh auth. Ships a sync script (profile.d) that installs skills from GitHub repos on first login and creates per-agent symlinks. No token needed — uses the gh auth already on the PVC. Public skills are also installed at build time as a fallback.

skills.description: Comma-separated list of skill packages (GitHub repos) to install

agents.description: Comma-separated agent names to create symlinks for (e.g. 'devin,claude-code,codex'). Default '*' = all known agents
